# From words to work — productivity tools that turn what AI can describe into work that actually gets done

> Independent macOS software by cygnus (https://github.com/cygnusyang). We make productivity tools that turn what AI can describe into work that actually gets done. This file records only facts verifiable in the apps, their public repositories and the pages linked below. Pricing below describes the direct-download channel; the Mac App Store builds are still in review.

Last updated 2026-11-06. No promises for features that have not shipped.

## Products

### KaidoPlan — project planning workbench for AI projects (macOS 14+)

- **Problem**: AI agents (Claude Code, Codex and similar) execute tasks one at a time, while the plan itself ends up scattered across chat history. KaidoPlan holds the WBS, dependencies, dates and progress in one plan that people and agents can inspect.
- **Plan file**: the plan is a single local plain-JSON file with the `.kaido` extension (`formatVersion` 2). It can be read, written and validated.
- **Scheduling**: forward and backward passes over dependencies and constraints compute the **critical path** and per-task slack, and surface **violations** — date conflicts, dependency cycles and tasks outside the project window.
- **Agent interface**: a built-in MCP server (**21 tools**, stdio JSON-RPC) plus a CLI, covering tasks, dependencies, resources, baselines, scheduling, violation checks and WBS import.
- **Direct-download pricing (current model, shipped with KaidoPlan v3.1.0)**:
  - **30-day full-feature trial**: every feature unlocked, no account, no card.
  - When the trial ends the app **downgrades to the free tier** instead of switching off: the full GUI planning workbench remains, an agent can **read** the plan over MCP/CLI but cannot write to it, and delivery-report exports are limited to **3 per month** (preview unlimited). Nothing already built is locked or deleted.
  - **KaidoPlan Pro — $9.99 / year**: unlocks AI write-back (task status, actual dates, new tasks) through the MCP/CLI tools and unlimited delivery-report exports. Cancel anytime.
  - KaidoPlan direct-download purchases carry a 14-day no-questions-asked refund: https://ai.cygnusyang.top/refund
- **Install**:
  - App: `brew install --cask cygnusyang/kaidoplan/kaidoplan`
  - CLI + MCP: `brew install cygnusyang/kaidoplan/kaidoplan-cli`
  - Or GitHub Releases: https://github.com/cygnusyang/KaidoPlan/releases/latest
- **Pages**: https://ai.cygnusyang.top/kaidoplan/ (English) · https://ai.cygnusyang.top/kaidoplan/zh (Chinese)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/cygnusyang/KaidoPlan

### Bitcoffer — local-first password and credential manager (macOS 14+)

- **Problem**: passwords, keys and credentials need to be usable by people and by AI agents without passing through a third-party server.
- **How it works**: an encrypted on-device vault, Touch ID unlock and the App Sandbox; no cloud sync, no account, no telemetry, and the only outbound request is the update check. A local MCP server hands secrets to agents without returning the secret values to the model. "local-first" here is Bitcoffer's own product-level security commitment, not a label applied to the whole product line.
- **Price**: **$9.99 USD per year**. Live terms: https://ai.cygnusyang.top/pricing
- **Install**: `brew install --cask cygnusyang/bitcoffer/bitcoffer` or GitHub Releases: https://github.com/cygnusyang/bitcoffer-releases/releases/latest
- **Pages**: https://ai.cygnusyang.top/bitcoffer/ (Chinese) · https://ai.cygnusyang.top/bitcoffer/en (English)
